initial.subject: Camera pictogram
initial.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one isolated flat pictogram for a research-paper figure, printed about 10 mm wide. Flat vector-like solid fills with consistent charcoal-blue outline, restrained two-color treatment, clean silhouette. Front orthographic view, centered with generous transparent margins. No photorealistic materials, gradients, glossy reflections, product render lighting, shadows, texture, fine hardware details, perspective or 3D depth. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, arrows, axes, connectors, legends, surrounding panels or full diagrams. True transparent background. Subject: a simplified camera with one broad body, a small top prism hump and one large circular lens. Dark blue outline #304D68 and pale blue fill #E5EEF5. A single dark inner lens disk with no shine. The camera alone, clearly recognizable at small scale.
